items.title: TAP Q2 Deep Dive: Margin Pressures Persist as Molson Coors Leans on Brand and Portfolio Initiatives
items.summary: Beer company Molson Coors (NYSE:TAP) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales fell by 3.3% year on year to $3.10 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.58 per share was 4.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
